nodes.description: address public owner; privileged address set in constructor and used as access-control anchor and fee recipient.
mapping(address => uint) public balances; per-player withdrawable balance.
address[6] public leaders; current holder of each mash slot.
uint[6] public buyins; required stake per slot, initialized with finney amounts.
constructor(): sets owner to msg.sender and initializes leaders and buyins arrays.
publicGetBalance(address player) view: returns balances[player].
publicGetState() view: returns the leaders array.
ownerChange(uint index, address holder): owner-only reassignment of a leader slot that still holds the owner.
userWithdraw(): zeroes the caller balance then transfers it out via msg.sender.transfer.
userChallenge(uint index) payable: stakes msg.value against a leader slot, outcome decided by blockhash-derived pseudo-randomness.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance indexing and transfer target.
msg.sender.transfer(amount): external value call that hands control to an arbitrary address.
uint(blockhash(block.number - 1)) used to derive the challenge outcome; block-dependent, manipulable randomness.
buyins[index] * 95 / 100 and buyins[index] * 5 / 100 payout arithmetic and balance accumulation.
Parameter player of publicGetBalance, used as mapping key.
Parameter index of ownerChange, selects the leader slot.
Parameter holder of ownerChange, the new leader address.
Parameter index of userChallenge, selects the leader slot and required buyin.
Local amount in userWithdraw, cached balance then passed to transfer.
Local random in userChallenge, derived from blockhash, leaders[index] and msg.sender.

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged state variable.
msg.sender flows into constructor to initialize owner and the leaders array.
constructor initializes every leaders slot with the owner address.
constructor initializes buyins with fixed finney amounts.
publicGetBalance reads balances mapping.
player parameter selects the balances key read by publicGetBalance.
publicGetState returns the leaders array.
msg.sender is checked against owner in require, gating ownerChange.
ownerChange reads owner both for the access check and the leaders[index] == owner guard.
index parameter selects the leaders slot modified by ownerChange.
holder parameter is written into the leaders array by ownerChange.
ownerChange writes leaders[index], mutating privileged state after an owner check.
msg.sender is used as the balances key and the transfer recipient in userWithdraw.
userWithdraw reads and zeroes balances[msg.sender].
local amount is assigned from balances[msg.sender] inside userWithdraw.
userWithdraw performs an external value call, the classic reentrancy entry point into this contract or its caller.
the transfer hands execution to msg.sender, whose fallback can re-enter the contract.
the cached amount computed from balances is the value sent in the external transfer callback.
index parameter selects the slot, buyin and leader used by userChallenge.
userChallenge reads buyins[index] for the stake requirement and payout math.
msg.sender feeds the pseudo-random computation and the balance/leader writes in userChallenge.
blockhash-derived randomness decides the win/lose branch, making the outcome block/timestamp dependent.
userChallenge computes the outcome from blockhash(block.number - 1), a manipulable block-dependent input.
userChallenge credits balances for the challenger, the defender and the owner.
payout arithmetic products (buyins * 95 / 100 and * 5 / 100) feed the losing branch balance updates.
userChallenge writes balances using multiplication/division arithmetic on the buyin amount.
userChallenge replaces leaders[index] with msg.sender on a winning outcome.
local random is computed and then branched on inside userChallenge.

normalization_plan.reason: player is only a lookup key for publicGetBalance and should be folded into that function node.
index parameter exists solely to select the leaders slot inside ownerChange; fold into the function.
holder parameter is only the value assigned to leaders[index] in ownerChange; fold into the function.
index parameter of userChallenge only selects the slot/buyin and should be merged into that function node.
local amount is a transient copy of balances used for the transfer in userWithdraw; fold into the function.
local random is a transient value derived inside userChallenge and should be merged into that function node.
